title: BioDisco: Multi-agent hypothesis generation with dual-mode evidence, iterative feedback and temporal evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Using a Bradley-Terry paired comparison model with a 'home advantage' parameter to estimate order effect bias when an LLM judge evaluates pairs of generated hypotheses.

Applying a Bayesian polytomous Rasch model (item-response theory) with rater-specific random effects to disentangle individual human rater leniency and severity biases from the actual hypothesis quality scores.
